PRE_FREEZE_WRITE_VS_FREEZE: If membership write CAS commits first, shard freeze CAS observes stale SHARD_STATE_VERSION and must retry including the write.
If shard freeze CAS commits first, a stale membership writer fails expected SHARD_STATE_VERSION.
Therefore a canonical pre-freeze membership change cannot be invisible to the frozen snapshot.
POST_PIN_WRITE_VS_COMPLETE: No normal membership write may enter a FROZEN shard under the active pinned closure.
A post-pin membership create/renew/suspend/retire/revoke must first win Mission Fence REOPEN_REQUIRED expected-version CAS.
If REOPEN wins first, COMPLETE using the old Mission Fence STATE_VERSION fails.
If COMPLETE wins first, REOPEN fails and the membership write cannot enter the completed closure generation.
Therefore the original invisible-membership-change TOCTOU execution is removed.
SAFETY_REPRODUCTION.ABA_RESISTANCE: Mission Fence STATE_VERSION is monotonic under [039]-[041], and V2 requires monotonic SHARD_STATE_VERSION/FREEZE_GENERATION, so the reviewed ordering does not rely on reusable versions.

V1_REVIEW_FINDINGS_DISPOSITION.R1_FREEZE_MUTATION_CAS_DOMAIN: ADDRESSED by one authoritative shard CAS domain for both membership mutations and freeze.
V1_REVIEW_FINDINGS_DISPOSITION.R2_COMPLETE_TOCTOU_REMAINS: ADDRESSED by mandatory Mission Fence REOPEN CAS before any post-pin normal membership write.
V1_REVIEW_FINDINGS_DISPOSITION.R1_OBSERVER_NAMESPACE_LAW_CONFLICT: ADDRESSED by removing the observer bypass and retaining real membership records under [217].
V1_REVIEW_FINDINGS_DISPOSITION.R2_PINNED_MEMBERSHIP_ACCOUNTING: ADDRESSED because any post-pin record-set change invalidates the old closure before the write.

REASON: V2 strengthens closure admission/completion preconditions without weakening any explicit V16-RC1.3 requirement.
The Constitution requires sharded membership and CAS but does not forbid an authoritative per-shard fence state or additional Mission Fence binding fields.
Clause [214] states necessary COMPLETE conditions; V2 adds stronger fail-closed conditions and does not authorize COMPLETE when any listed [214] condition fails.

Clause [197] permits post-barrier participation but does not guarantee admission into an already completed closure generation; V2 preserves participation by reopening before a canonical membership write when needed.

MANDATORY_COMPOSITION_REQUIREMENTS: Every existing membership record mutation must still satisfy record-level EXPECTED_RECORD_GENERATION -> N+1 under [079] in the same canonical operation that satisfies the shard CAS requirement.
Every Mission Fence mutation introduced by V2 must satisfy [039]-[041] STATE_VERSION CAS and must compose with the active CLOSURE global transition rules [042]-[046].
USER_STOP [164]-[168] remains preemptive over closure/freeze/reopen and may not be delayed by shard freeze.
REOPEN_REQUIRED invalidates the closure attempt/pin; it must not by itself reopen WORK_ADMISSION_GATE, MUTATION_GATE, or INTEGRATION_GATE for normal product engineering.
The V2 protocol must be canonically bound/activated as control authority before it is used to resolve the static P0; the existence of this candidate or this review alone is not activation.
Closure torture tests listed by V2 must execute against the eventual control implementation before VERIFIED_GLOBAL_CODE_CLOSURE.
